parts.name: base frame

physics.Basic_description: A thin, flat rectangular frame made of light blue cardboard or stiff paper, forming the structural backing of the inner sleeve.
physics.Functional_description: Provides rigidity and shape to the inner pocket that holds the disc.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the edge if exposed, but usually covered by the outer sleeve.
physics.reason: Cardboard sheets are modeled as solid thin plates for physics purposes, distinct from hollow shells enclosing air.

parts.description: A thin, flat rectangular frame made of light blue cardboard or stiff paper, forming the structural backing of the inner sleeve.
parts.function: Provides rigidity and shape to the inner pocket that holds the disc.

parts.name: sleeve pocket

physics.Basic_description: The green-colored inner surface of the paper pocket where the disc rests, visible inside the frame.
physics.Functional_description: The contact surface that secures the CD within the inner sleeve assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; it is an internal surface.
physics.reason: Thin paper sheet component, effectively solid in volume terms relative to its thickness.

parts.description: The green-colored inner surface of the paper pocket where the disc rests, visible inside the frame.
parts.function: The contact surface that secures the CD within the inner sleeve assembly.

parts.name: disc body

physics.Basic_description: A standard optical disc with a reflective data surface and a central hole, partially visible inside the sleeve.
physics.Functional_description: The media storage object contained within the case.
physics.Grasped_description: Graspable by the rim or center hole if the sleeve is open, though delicate.
physics.reason: A CD is a solid thin disk of polycarbonate plastic.

parts.description: A standard optical disc with a reflective data surface and a central hole, partially visible inside the sleeve.
parts.function: The media storage object contained within the case.

parts.name: sleeve shell

physics.Basic_description: The main outer yellow envelope or sleeve made of matte paper/cardstock that encloses the inner components.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the inner sleeve and disc from dust and scratches; the primary handle for the object.
physics.Grasped_description: The primary grasp target; a gripper would pinch the flat outer surface or the edge of the sleeve.
physics.reason: It is a folded paper envelope enclosing empty space (and the inner parts), acting as a thin-walled shell.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
